correctness.rationale: The implicit equation is globally strictly increasing, producing a smooth odd map. Its derivative is monotone in absolute state, so |P'(0)|<1 exactly characterizes the global exponential contraction regimes. At equality the strict |P(x)|<|x| and positive cubic coefficient prove global but algebraic attraction, except when trajectories hit zero finitely. Above equality the tanh(z)/z monotonicity proves unique symmetric 2-cycle, with multiplier strictly inside the unit disc and a square-root onset. Finite independent bisection tests returned VERIFY_OK parameter_checks=339 critical_algebraic_cases=3; the full quantified proof is in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Natural one-cell specialization of a recent generalized-argument Hopfield stability problem yields an exact structural all-gain advance-phase boundary and complementary sharp supercritical flip with critical algebraic relaxation. It resolves a mathematically meaningful gap between sufficient contractivity bounds and the true stability/oscillation transition, including all parameter boundaries. The result is not a routine relabeling of the earlier sufficient theorem; no full supercritical attractor classification is claimed.
